slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Onsoo should enter the US in 2027 through Amazon, the only route within the board's limits, and gate the launch on ad cost
The US is worth entering: K-beauty drove 39% of US facial skincare growth, and the Amazon pilot nearly doubled its sales
–	K-beauty sales rose 89% in 2021–25, six times other brands' growth
–	Pilot buyers rebuy at 29% within 90 days, near the 31% peer benchmark
Only Amazon-led fits the board's limits: retail-led breaks the cash cap, and Japan stays small
–	Retail-led needs $20.8M by 2030 and cuts 2027 group margin to 4.5%
–	Japan pays back by 2029 but adds only $7M of revenue in 2030
The retail case rests on weak assumptions: newcomers like Onsoo sell 2.6 units per door a week, not 4.5
–	The leading retailer removes newcomers selling under 4.0 units a week
–	The 0.71 correlation behind the halo fits doors following online sales
Amazon-led pays back by 2030 only if ad cost stays below 28.6% of sales, so approve it with gates
–	At the 32% ad cost of scaling peers, payback slips past 2030
–	Raise the retail trigger from 15% to 20% awareness
